title: Hanoi Events Database (TUNG TA TUNG TANG)
summary: Specific research, architecture, and data collection for a comprehensive Hanoi events database. This project implements the LINHX LAB Scanning Pattern to catalog events in Hanoi for March 2026. After rejecting initial generated data, it pivoted to real-time browser scanning via the LinhX Crawl Server, reaching an initial milestone of 38 verified real-world events (concerts, exhibitions, heritage festivals) and expanding the venue registry to 150+ locations in Hanoi.
